title: Grind and Brew Coffee from Whole Beans
summary: Weigh whole coffee beans on a kitchen scale, grind them in an electric blade grinder, and brew a cup of coffee.

nodes.name: Set up grinder and scale
nodes.instruction_novice: Plug in the coffee grinder and place the kitchen scale on a flat surface. Make sure the grinder cup is clean and dry.
nodes.end_state: Grinder is plugged in and the scale sits on the cutting board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Set up grinder and scale?

nodes.name: Tare the scale
nodes.instruction_novice: Turn on the scale and press tare so it reads zero. If you use a container, tare with it on.

checks.question: Is this step done: Tare the scale?

nodes.name: Scoop beans onto scale
nodes.instruction_novice: Open the coffee bag and scoop whole beans onto the scale. Aim for about 15 to 20 grams per cup.
nodes.end_state: Beans sit on the scale showing the target weight.

checks.question: Is this step done: Scoop beans onto scale?

nodes.name: Reseal the coffee bag
nodes.instruction_novice: Squeeze the air out of the bag and roll or clip it closed. This keeps the remaining beans fresh.
nodes.end_state: Coffee bag is folded closed and set aside.

checks.question: Is this step done: Reseal the coffee bag?

nodes.name: Load beans into grinder
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour the weighed beans into the grinder cup. Put the lid on firmly.
nodes.end_state: Beans are inside the grinder with the lid secured.

checks.question: Is this step done: Load beans into grinder?

nodes.name: Grind the beans
nodes.instruction_novice: Press and hold the button in short pulses, shaking the grinder gently. Stop when the grounds look like coarse sand for drip coffee.
nodes.end_state: Grinder holds evenly ground coffee with no whole beans.

checks.question: Is this step done: Grind the beans?

nodes.name: Heat the water
nodes.instruction_novice: Heat water to just off the boil, around 93 to 96°C. Use about 250 ml per cup.
nodes.end_state: Kettle or pot of hot water is ready.

checks.question: Is this step done: Heat the water?

nodes.name: Prepare the brewer
nodes.instruction_novice: Put a filter in your brewer and rinse it with a little hot water. Discard the rinse water.
nodes.end_state: Wet filter sits in the brewer over an empty mug or carafe.

checks.question: Is this step done: Prepare the brewer?

nodes.name: Add grounds to filter
nodes.instruction_novice: Tap the grounds out of the grinder into the filter. Shake gently to level the bed.
nodes.end_state: Level bed of grounds sits in the filter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add grounds to filter?

nodes.name: Bloom the coffee
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour just enough hot water to wet all the grounds. Wait about 30 seconds while it bubbles.
nodes.end_state: Grounds are evenly wet and puffed up.

checks.question: Is this step done: Bloom the coffee?

nodes.name: Pour remaining water
nodes.instruction_novice: Slowly pour the rest of the water in circles over the grounds. Let it drain completely.
nodes.end_state: Brewed coffee fills the mug and the filter has drained.

checks.question: Is this step done: Pour remaining water?

nodes.name: Clean grinder and serve
nodes.instruction_novice: Unplug the grinder and brush out leftover grounds. Then enjoy your coffee.
nodes.end_state: Grinder is unplugged and empty, and the mug of coffee is ready.

checks.question: Is this step done: Clean grinder and serve?
